meta: Write an SOP for new employees with AI, so newcomers don't have to ask about the same task again and again.

muc.title: New hires ask the same thing
muc.text: New hires keep asking about the same task because the process only exists in the veterans' heads.

muc.title: What a process is
muc.text: An SOP, a standard operating procedure, is a step-by-step list so anyone who follows it gets the same result.

muc.title: Messy is fine
muc.text: Just describe how you do it, even in a messy way. Ask a chatbot to arrange it into numbered steps, each starting with a verb.

muc.title: Let a new hire try it
muc.text: Give the draft to a new hire to try. Wherever they hesitate, add a screenshot or a note.

muc.title: One task in five steps
muc.text: Pick a task you do every week, describe it to AI and ask it to write it as five steps.

thu: Pick a task you do every week, describe it to AI and ask it to write it as 5 steps.
